units.source_text: “它叫阿咬，不管是什么样的鬼神，只要与它为敌，都会被他咬死。

en.t: It is called Ayao; no matter what kind of demon or spirit it is, if it makes an enemy of him, he will bite it to death.

units.source_text: 对了，我和哥哥们送你的狗，不管你在哪里，只要吹响笛子，它们就会回到你身边。

en.t: By the way, the dogs my brothers and I gave you will return to your side wherever you are, as long as you blow the flute.

units.source_text: 如果没有笛子，它们就不会回来，千万要记住啊。”

en.t: If you do not have the flute, they will not come back, so be absolutely sure to remember that.
